- **Today** (`/today`, also in the top menu) — the supervisor's home screen and
  what the installed phone app opens to: one card per paper day sheet, and only
  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at

  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under

  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at

  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**

  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at

  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**

  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at

  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at

  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at

  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**

  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at

  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at

  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at

  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  the ones that person's department fills in. Compost roles see **Form C-1**
  (Compost Day Sheet) and **Form C-2** (Daily Bunker & Tunnel Log); growing roles
  see **Form G-1** (Growing Day Sheet) and **Form G-2** (Daily Harvest); Admin
  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.

  and Farm Manager hold every stage permission, so they see all four under
  department headings. Each card shows what is waiting — how many batches sit at
  each step, how many bunkers and tunnels to read, how many rooms are in crop —
  and what has already been done today. Below the cards, a read-only list shows
  where every batch stands, with its bunker/tunnel/room, day count and last
  reading.
